fee_notes: The Initial Franchise Fee is a fixed $30,000, payable within seven business days after execution of the Franchise Agreement. Additional fees disclosed under Item 5 include: Security Deposit of $10,000 (refundable under certain conditions); Service Fee of $500/month (prepaid in 6-month increments of $3,000); Equipment and Utensil Fee of $15,000; optional Design Fee of $500/outlet; optional Initial Training Fee (free for up to 2 trainees, $1,000 per additional trainee); and optional Pre-Open Support Fee of $500 per instructor per day. All fees are non-refundable except the Security Deposit.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee is $30,000, and the Fee is payable within seven business days after execution of the Franchise Agreement.
